notes.title: Version 1.06 released.
notes.content:
Version 1.06 of the application been released. 

[list]
[*] New model released.
[*] Can setup the ffmpeg path from the config window.
[*] Detect on FFMPEG if some codecs are avaiable, if so, appear on the GUI.
[*] If input is image sequence with alpha and output PNG senquence, it support alpha.
[*] Can export GIF (limited to 50fps).
[*] Changelog button inside the app.
[*] Bug Fix: Clean Queue on Cancel.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Can setup the ffmpeg path from the config window.
